notes: The classifier for individual teeth is ซี่ (e.g., ฟันสองซี่, 'two teeth'). Common compounds include แปรงฟัน (to brush teeth) and หมอฟัน (dentist).

senses.definition: One of the hard, white structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing.

examples.text: ฉันต้องไปหาหมอฟันเพื่อตรวจฟัน

notes: The word 'ฟัน' functions as both a noun (tooth) and a verb (to slash, hack, or chop). In an A2 context, you will most frequently encounter it as a noun, particularly when talking about health or the body. When used as a verb, it describes a forceful, aggressive cutting motion, often used in martial arts or when talking about chopping through thick objects.
